text:
```yaml
name: Dependency Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  dependency-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@e1b1c3b5c1b8b8c3a5d2f9e4a6d7f8e9b0c1d2e
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Run dependency review
        uses: actions/dependency-review-action@c3b5f5c2a4d6e7f8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          fail-on-severity: high
          comment-summary-in-pr: true
```
